text:
Lee: Quick heads-up — PR #23821 needs to land before Wed maintenance (00:30 UTC). It's blocked on a flaky mac e2e and needs a small rebase. Can I get eyes and a rebase window?
Tara: can you rebase onto main? how large are the conflicts? :eyes:
Lee: tiny — two files. I can rebase now but CI mac queue is slow. Asking for a small priority bump or a canary slot if mac flakes.
Sanjay: @Lee if you rebase tag me and I'll bump the queue. Reminder: maintenance blackout Wed 00:30–01:30 UTC.
Lee: tagged @Sanjay — rebased locally, pushing now:
```bash
git checkout -b rebase-23821 main
git rebase main
git push -f origin rebase-23821
```
ci-bot: Build started for PR #23821 — mac-e2e queued (position 3).
Tara: :thumbsup: can we prioritize? customer is waiting for the fix.
Sanjay: I can bump to priority once linux & unit tests are green. mac is flaky; will run manual job if it flakes twice.
ci-bot: linux/unit tests passed. mac-e2e failed — timeout on screenshot test. Rerun scheduled.
Julian: if mac keeps flaking, option: manual canary rollout to dedicated and a quick rollback plan. avoids blocking the release window.
Lee: agreed — if mac fails twice I'll request canary. For now can anyone give a quick +1 on the review? @Tara?
Tara: +1, left a tiny nit (non-blocking). approving. :white_check_mark:
Sanjay: queue bumped; manual mac run started. ETA ~8m.
ci-bot: mac-e2e rerun passed. All checks green. Ready to merge when you are.
Alex: FYI we have a small freeze at 23:50 UTC, but since everything's green you can land before that.
Lee: merging now. thanks all :tada:
